import type { GameEvent } from '@src/types/event';
import { getBackendTaskConfigPage } from '@src/api/bot/task-config';
import { setBackendTaskSlotStep } from '@src/api/bot/task-config-action';
import { getBackendRobotIdentity } from '@src/api/bot/identity';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { renderOverview, renderSlot, sendPage } from '@src/response/task/views';
import type { Next } from 'alemonjs';
import { Format } from 'alemonjs';

export default async (e: GameEvent, next: Next) => {
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const identity = await getBackendRobotIdentity(e.UserId, request);

  if (identity.account.status !== 'registered') {
    return next();
  }

  const uid = identity.account.playerId;
  const slot = Number(e.__route?.params?.slot);
  const step = Number(e.__route?.params?.step);
  const content = String(e.__route?.params?.content ?? '').trim();

  if (!slot) {
    const { config, limits } = await getBackendTaskConfigPage(e.UserId, uid, request);

    renderOverview(e, config.slots, limits);

    return;
  }

  if (!step || !content) {
    // Let Go judge the slot even when this is the editor-opening form. The
    // invalid-step result for a valid slot is intentionally read-only.
    const intent = await setBackendTaskSlotStep(e.UserId, uid, slot, 0, '', request);

    const { config, limits } = intent.page ?? (await getBackendTaskConfigPage(e.UserId, uid, request));

    if (intent.outcome === 'invalid_slot') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`槽位只能是1到${limits.slotCount}`);
      sendPage(e, '任务设置', md);

      return;
    }
    renderSlot(e, slot, config.slots[slot - 1].steps, limits.maxSteps, config.slots[slot - 1].alias);

    return;
  }

  const result = await setBackendTaskSlotStep(e.UserId, uid, slot, step, content, request);

  const { config, limits } = result.page ?? (await getBackendTaskConfigPage(e.UserId, uid, request));

  if (result.outcome !== 'saved') {
    const messages: Record<string, string> = {
      invalid_slot: `槽位只能是1到${limits.slotCount}`,
      invalid_step: `步骤只能是1到${limits.maxSteps}`,
      empty: '任务指令不能为空',
      too_long: '单条任务指令不能超过50个字',
      nested: '任务内不能再嵌套 /任务 指令',
      out_of_order: `请先设置第${result.steps.length + 1}步`
    };
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(messages[result.outcome] ?? '任务设置失败');
    sendPage(e, `任务设置 ${slot}`, md);

    return;
  }
  renderSlot(e, slot, result.steps, limits.maxSteps, config.slots[slot - 1].alias);
};
